comments: Bottleneck-widening experiment (bottleneck_ch=96 vs phase 1's 64): clean, trustworthy negative. Completed 300 epochs without collapsing; checkpoints are genuinely QAT-active (deep in the post-freeze region). Peak QAT-active val dice ~0.40 (epoch 275-284) -- 0.11-0.12 below phase 1's real checkpoint (val dice 0.5144, kuralsnet_npu_seg.json) despite 1.21x MAC headroom and a healthy, non-collapsing training trajectory. Widening is abandoned as a capacity lever; phase 1 (bottleneck_ch=64) remains the final architecture. No further relaunch planned.
